summary: Array of geographic zone definitions; tasks/vehicles reference zones by integer id for eligibility.
range: Array of zone objects. Each requires id + (geometry OR geofence_id).
constraints: Each zone requires id and exactly one of geometry / geofence_id.
businessRules: zones defines: An array of objects to specify geometry of all the zones involved. Each object corresponds to a single zone. A valid zone can be a [geoJSON](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7946#page-9) po…
Each element in zones must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: zones.geometry, zones.geofence_id, jobs.zones. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Vehicle's allowed_zones must include the job/shipment's zones.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
Vehicle and job zones must intersect. Vehicle without zone restrictions can serve any zone.
validationRules: A zone with neither geometry nor geofence_id -> 400.
testingGuidance: Positive: a Polygon zone referenced by a job's zones.
Negative: a zone missing both geometry and geofence_id -> 400.
Interaction: Infeasible: job in zone 2 with every vehicle restricting or not allowing zone 2 -> unassigned.
Interaction: Positive: job zones [1], vehicle allowed_zones [1] -> served.
